messages.loc.src.data.longberth.field.line.7e40ab: A crew berth over the hold, fuel in the standpipe, a rail that patches scars. The Long Berth works.
messages.loc.src.data.longberth.field.line.dd13d2: She stops turning. Mooring points welded, a beacon lit — she is home enough to dock.
messages.loc.src.data.longberth.field.line.f7021b: Power on the hardpoints. The yard flood lights the drift — trophies stay put under her lamps.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.05090c518ba: Your base run left a debris field where a posting used to be. The posting had people in it. The paperwork is finished. I am not.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.0672fcc01fe: I flew with Vols, once. The way you take a lane — the drift, the patience, the sudden violence when it is owed — it reads like her flight book. Do not tell anyone I said so.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.07d93af57d2: Two more hulls went on the wrong side of my list this month. Yours keeps refusing to stay written. I have started keeping your page in a different drawer.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.0979cc366b2: Your breathing pattern suggests unregistered calm. Schedule an assessment before it becomes a habit we cannot bill.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.0c323d04b83: Six months in the colony, and the first thing I hear is your transponder back on the board. Berth-side, first bell. You are buying because you can afford to now.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.0f8bfa99819: You cracked that rock and our contracts collapsed under the surplus. Fifty crews ate your payday for a week. The tally remembers whose shot did it.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.10a120c866f: If the Tessera still flies, someone is flying her. Maera owed me a bottle and a debt she never got to settle. The bottle is paid. The debt rides with the hull. Take care of her; she is older than she looks.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.13c85491f9c: And it is billable. Attend one session and learn to fear the machinery professionally. Group rates for crew; the hull attends free.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.14f8150752c: The Tessera's last filed crew list is a legal document now. You are not on it. Neither is anyone else, which is the point. The list is evidence and inheritance both.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.19f73e9dd21: Know which rocks will be rocks before you arrive. Premium tier tells you which rocks are lying.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.1a91790c13c: Captain Vols wrote routes in the chart margins in pencil, so the ship could change its mind. If the Tessera still carries her charts, page sixty-one is hers.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.1b381ed3af8: Our haulers run light on guns and heavy on cargo. Your silhouette would look good on their flank. Escort terms posted at the claim office.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.1b61bf4cc16: What Maera was actually hauling is not on any manifest — it is why the hull went down and why it came back up. When you find the page, the page finds you.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.1c261133478: I still hold the Tessera's spare custody seals from before she was lost. They authenticate to her signature. If the hull is yours now, they are yours — no charge, she hated paying twice.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.1f5bac44d84: Your "salvage" of a Meridian consignment has been reconciled as theft with good lighting. The invoice follows. The warrant follows the invoice.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.26736bb58a0: The frontier needs pilots who answer a mayday without asking which flag. Your record says you did exactly that. Paid in fuel, favor, and honest trouble.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.26a901f1a98: You walked the station and the station noticed. That is all the letter says. It has been waiting longer than you have been flying.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.27065f1f38b: Your silhouette appears in three incident reports and one ballad. Only one of those is admissible. Guess which concerns us.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.2980142e882: An automated asset under your registry was lost. Depreciation is cruel and immediate. Enclosed: the bill for the depreciation report.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.2c0a4eda562: Word travels the gantries faster than the wire. The crew that loaded your hold this morning worked careful because they figured a pilot like you notices.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.2cd125a85d7: You disabled a licensed hunter. The license survives. The grudge is filed under your name and accrues like interest.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.2f5d8533be7: Your record shows you can end a fight you did not start. Licensed bounty work pays in warrants, not promises. Registry desk, third window.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.322e1557dd5: Your transit through a restricted corridor was logged. The corridor bills by the meter and the audacity. Attached.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.35b49a5d77a: The raider had us cold and you turned into its approach like it owed you money. I owe you my hull. This letter is the deposit.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.35be6c28574: The wreck you left had a name and a crew roster longer than yours. The Reach does not file grievances. The Reach keeps lists.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.365867e0598: The job you walked out of was a test with a body count. You passed. That is worse. The Quiet does not threaten; it deprioritizes.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.371051215f9: The Directorate observes your throughput with professional interest. Continued compliance is the cheapest form of privacy currently offered. No reply is required or read.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.38339703f05: You damaged a licensed hunter's hull beyond deductible. The Guild bills the target. Consider it a compliment in invoice form.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.3c0495cfd70: They are saying the corridor is safe enough to raise rates on. That is the highest compliment freight knows. Do not let them charge you for the compliment.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.3dbf36a053b: I am the correspondent your wire calls "local" when it wants to sound harmless. A story is forming around your hull. I would rather hear it from the hull.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.3fa1771dd28: Your last manifest cleared. The variance on line four was within tolerance this time. This is not a favor; it is a note that I noticed.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.3ffda1b6294: I am required to inform you that your file has gained a page. It is not a kind page. Further pages are available at market rates.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.407fa5ceb47: The children asked why a ship stopped. I said sometimes the world stops for you. They made me write it down. Thank you for stopping.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.41b1b5de78b: The manifest-blank service you requested has concluded. Your discretion was flawless. Your bill is not.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.45bdef625fa: I broke open the seal log because somebody had to. Your name is on a clean page in a dirty book. Guard the page; the book does not get cleaner.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.471c1ec499e: Your survey filings are unusually complete. The Archive pays for charted edges — POIs verified, wrecks identified, rumors confirmed or buried in writing.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.483d4fe100d: First license, first hull, first terror. Then I watched you dock through a storm front like the wind was an employee. Whatever you are doing, it looks survivable.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.4997f7be285: A hauler on its lane is a promise to the tide. You pulled it off like a fish on a hook. The tide keeps the same promise about you.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.4a522daa9bf: Our records show your hull exists. Coverage for existence is available for a limited eternity. Act now; regret later in writing.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.4c42a30959d: found metal. warm metal. you flew close and the old parts woke. latch-child keeps what latch-child finds. come take it or leave it warm.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.4c5424f1b67: Our auditors detected four minutes of unbilled calm in your last berth stay. License your leisure or return the minutes. Appeals processed in order of despair.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.4d8012e52eb: We watched. The machines do not open for most. Whatever the gate read in your silhouette, keep carrying it.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.5400a5ae02f: The union does not pay for the photograph. The union certifies, after the fact, that a photograph existed. Certification is what pays, and certification looks away from the stripping. Rate card attached.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.55cf74fe21b: The tide takes hulls that fight it and carries hulls that read it. Your record reads like someone who reads. There is freight that only moves in the deep current.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.55e052bc045: The Navy notes pilots who answer distress without a contract. Auxiliary patrol work is not glory. It is fuel, clearance, and a uniform the law reads twice.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.569ed90b73f: The Reach pays pilots who make debtors honest. Your record says you can stand in a lane and be believed. Collect for us and the tolls reverse.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.56db2d362fe: What you did at the wreck was seen by people who have learned to watch. The Pitborn do not write threats. We write invitations. Decline carefully.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.58df549bd19: Captain Vols kept berth nine painted for a hull that never came back. If you are flying her now, the berth is paid through the season. House policy: paint it anyway.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.5f8f6e617ee: In this economy a witnessed signature on your soul is the only hedge that appreciates. Limited slots per hull.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.65782308dfc: We insure pilots who finish. Your completion record qualifies you for bonded work — the runs that pay for the risk, priced in writing.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.658d841d0d2: Whatever you paid for the secondhand rig, it was worth it if it works and a lesson if it does not. Bring it by the stall when it does not. First look is free-ish.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.6db8350474e: Your fuel state was logged at critical. Replacement cells are priced per unit of panic. Prepay now to lock the panic rate.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.6e469821e2e: They wrote a ballad about your run. I was in the second verse. There is no third verse for me. The singer never asked.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.6eeb8c7efa8: Esteemed pilot: a crate of pre-collapse currency awaits a hull of your discretion. Small release fee required. Regards, a Prince of Sedna Dark.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.701ac7ef739: You keep a sealed hold sealed. That is the whole skill. Runs pay triple, questions pay nothing, and you will never learn our name twice.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.709bda583f2: A dozen pilots stood when your name came up. Management denies authorizing the standing. First round is on the house until further notice.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.70cb246ed97: The wreck left her locker unclaimed. A photo, two medals she never wore, and a book with a name in it. If the hull comes home, the locker does too.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.716e5a290be: The Tessera's drive had a harmonics fault she never fixed. It sings at exactly the wrong moment. We used to say the ship was talking. When you hear it, answer. She always did.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.736ce92f34f: A fine has been assessed under REF 44-C. Payment closes the file. Non-payment opens a second, more interesting file.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.7529179b2f4: You already do it. Get paid for it. Interview process is entirely non-verbal. Bring a hold.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.79030943aab: Trademark your callsign before someone braver does. Filing fee today, royalties never, peace of mind pending.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.7a1275bb10e: A hull loss requires a filing. Yours was dramatic enough to require two. Fees split evenly, condolences not included.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.7aea1e3c30f: I knew the crew. The company would have let them drift and called it variance. You turned around. The belt talks about who turns around.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.7b064e79a8f: Every deed you file in the Record is a page the university did not have to invent. History thanks you in advance for the citations and apologizes for the footnotes.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.7cde1b8ec97: The pit remembers pilots who did not look down on it. There is salvage only the Pitborn will let you touch. Terms are plain and so is the danger.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.7ebe226e894: Your freight seals verified on the first pass. Do you know how rare that is? The database agreed with the cargo and nobody had to die about it. Keep your paperwork honest.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.7f0223bc0f8: We ran the corridor with our lights on for the first time in months. Nobody had to file a report about us. That is the whole letter.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.7fd31ec69e2: Most pilots hide a warrant. You survived one. There is work for a hull that can carry a price on its nose without blinking. The booth knows the silhouette.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.82f9c9af238: You pulled our father's pod out of the dark. He is bad at letters. We are not. There is a plate of something warm under the counter whenever you dock.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.854845daf9c: Your outstanding note has escalated to bounty. This letter is the courtesy before the hunters. It is also the receipt for the courtesy.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.86337933205: Word is a warrant was priced on your hull and you priced it back down. When you need the same service from the other side, my booth knows your silhouette.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.8bb85adb4cc: Docking logged. Berth time, air draw, and the administrative pleasure of your company: itemized and attached. Pay before the next bell or the clamps learn your name.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.8bbc7af0227: The pod you will never admit you need is covered for only half a rescue. Upgrade to whole-rescue coverage before the math becomes personal.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.8c0154e0e67: We scattered. Some of us landed. Some of us are still the kind of thing you find in a pod. If you pull one in, that is one of ours. Tell them the ship kept flying.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.8c979cd8008: You asked once why anyone stays. Your Record is the answer some of us give now. It is not eloquent. It is evidence.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.8fea7aaee7d: You fly through my reach without paying the toll. The toll is not money yet. It is that I now know your silhouette. Deliver to me before I collect in kind.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.9140825568a: Your flight logs are history the moment you make them. The Archive accepts all records, flattering or otherwise. Especially otherwise.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.923a3fcc973: The file you asked about exists in the sealed collection. Existence is free. The collection is not. Bring a clearance or a reason that weighs the same.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.956da002c03: The lot seized under your name accrues storage by the shift. Collect it, contest it, or let the interest eat it for you.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.964d5069ce3: You run the corridor like you own a share of it. You do not. But you run it like someone who might someday, and that is worth a wave instead of a warning.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.96dc42a47c2: The fauna calls you logged are not noise. Every signature you filed is a sentence the field had never finished. Come argue about what they mean when the archive opens.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.9ad0c184496: You just have not heard your note yet. The Choir hears everything. First vigil is complimentary; tithes are the second verse.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.9bfcca879eb: I stamped your hull plate once and word is you treat it like a dare now. The weld holds because I made it hold. Stop testing my signature.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.9ca5d10a14d: The beacon was on your scope. Your log says you heard it. We buried a box with a name on it and the name should have been yours.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.a03c836397a: Statistically, so does someone. Return to the belt and receive a complimentary tally mark. Collect ten for a badge that means nothing but says plenty.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.a067fad5dce: Some freight rides the lifts, not the lanes. You have been below a floor before and come back. There is steady work for a hull that remembers the stairs.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.a0c4dfd9fc4: It is underperforming. Enroll in ore futures and let the market explain why this was inevitable. Terms apply. Terms always apply.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.a300cdab38e: I signed the plate because it held. If it opens at a seam, it opens on my signature, and I will find you before the vacuum does. Bring it back before the next long burn.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.a4276b3452d: Our premium berths offer ambient lighting, a wider berth cushion, and a concierge who says your name correctly the first time. Book now.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.a4e61d6a91d: The corridor you have been cleaning up was my income. I had contracts. Now I have a grudge and your callsign memorized.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.a58562c68d9: Your policy carried a deductible. The deductible has been carried. This is the carrying fee.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.a596ca1e9da: The dock slam at our berth generated a crew levy. The ring is straight again. Your account is not.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.ac2c2662c00: If it exists, we ship it. If it does not exist, we ship the apology. Now hiring and selling, interchangeable verbs.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.ad518f1504c: Your last three deliveries cleared without a seal flag. Meridian runs a standing route on this corridor — honest freight, boring money, on the books. Ask at the desk.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.adb2c287e11: Nothing is on page nine. That is the problem. Page nine is where the cargo you did not buy gets listed. Check your holds. Then decide who to bill.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.ae9151a67c2: Your craft consumed more reagents than the estimate pretended. The guild bills the gap. Craft something cheaper next time.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.af0d4e048c5: Berth four's ring still lists. The repair crew worked a double. Your insurance covered the plate, not the people under it. Fly a straighter approach.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.b215ef5faf0: The inspection fee you paid generated a second filing. That is how Gate 3 says hello. Your record currently says "no flags." Keep it that way; the alternative is my Tuesday.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.b25b602dff6: You took one of ours. Tolls are now doubled on your silhouette until the ledger balances or you do. Both are acceptable.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.b30d46a7209: My sister shipped under Vols and never shipped home. Seeing the hull on the board again felt like a visit. Do whatever she was going to do; she would have liked the company.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.b3b4e88d083: The Captain never ignored a distress call, even the ones that cost her. It is why the crew loved her and why the hull is a legend and why you should be careful about which trait you inherit.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.ba54b12fcf7: The official line is the Navy handles outlaws. The unofficial truth is a civilian hull did it faster. Keep the second part quiet; the first part keep doing.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.bb4cd95793d: You were told the case is testimony. It is. So is this letter. When they ask who corroborated, the answer is already filed under your name.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.bcb048a8aca: Third watch saw a ship reduce speed for a drifting pod instead of logging it as debris. The watch does not clap. The watch wrote this anyway.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.c41c13e30b4: Meet other independent pilots for low-stakes escort arrangements and shared toll-dodging. Frontier rates apply.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.c5b495f69e0: Every answer you gave someone else is on file somewhere. The question remains open because none of them matched. Answer when the answer changes.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.c662fe53f92: There is a run that pays what a run should never pay. You have the hull for it. Whether you have the exit is a separate invoice.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.c6c17891047: Your tuition built a wing. Your donations could name a shelf. Every shelf is a small immortality.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.c9f8f28a7f1: Your last sale broke a shortage the syndicate was milking. Half the desk bought you a drink in spirit. The other half filed a complaint about fairness. We prefer the first half.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.ca5b6c43bf1: Work performed, parts consumed, warranty excluded: attached. The welds hold. The debt holds longer.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.caf0950530c: Your flight telemetry is an outlier the Directorate wishes to study. A measurement contract pays for unmodified flight data. The hull stays yours. The data becomes ours.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.cc1825ea1fc: I keep the names of the ships that do not come back. Yours keeps getting written and keeps being wrong. The wrecks do not mind being wrong. I do. Fly home sometime.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.cf34c158720: Standing order, never countermanded: if the Tessera takes fire, the crew hits the pods before the hull hits the floor. Whoever is crew now should know the order stood.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.cf78ed3714f: Then you saw what they wrote me as. I fixed the recycler. The report fixed me. Thanks for not shooting.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.d1b53adf742: If your hull comes back wrong, we pay out. Payout is in candles. Candles are redeemable nowhere but burn beautifully.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.d20b331396e: A warehouse of orphaned freight seeks loving pilots. Slight water damage. Slight legal damage. Adopt today.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.d5ce3aa5004: The belt needs a hull that can crack a claim and not crack the crew. Your name came off the ore-flood wire with the right adjectives. Claim office, second bell.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.d629bcaecc7: You answered the last thing that asked by outlasting it. That was not an answer. It was evidence. The question remains open.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.de44387769a: Somewhere out there is a crate marked DO NOT FAIL. It is a large crate. The fee is proportionate. We provide the crate; you provide the not-failing.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.de8bc8ee716: The wire said a hull made noise at the rings and I knew the pilot before I read the callsign. Keep it loud enough to hear and quiet enough to bill.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.e6eff562136: He kept that gate eleven years and knew every hull by its lighting. You left him a job with no gate in it. I hope the cargo was worth a man's whole shape.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.e7758f542e1: Someone left a chip marked TESSERA under the rail. I did not read it. House policy: I read everything. Bring coin.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.e794b95e3ca: Certain doors open for the right cargo and no other. You carry the right silhouette. The pay is in routes the charts have not earned yet.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.e84cb945ab0: Your claim posted clean, which means somebody else filed the same rock tired. Second claim wins. I did not write the rule, I only charge for reading it.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.e9b81e321a4: The bar is under new management, same rates, no questions. Your stool is the third one. It remembers your tab better than the ledger does.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.ea34ec4e2d1: From a distance. Behind glass. Your ticket includes one complimentary retelling of the collapse, told with feeling.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.eaa865e72b1: Maera plotted a route she never filed — the one that was supposed to buy us all out. It is in the black box if you found it. The route was real. So was the buyout. Finish it if you dare.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.ecac52ecda6: The old crew protocol: survivors first, cargo second, pride never. Maera drilled it into us until it was reflex. If you have the hull, you have the obligation. It is a good one.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.ed5feb7e114: You ran a load past the checkpoint clean enough that the checkpoint is still wondering. The den noticed. The den approves. The den denies both.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.f0dc9686435: An officer witnessed your last assessment and countersigned the paperwork. The countersignature is a service. Services are billed. Attached.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.f218ad9fcbc: The vigil needs lamp oil and honest hauling. It is not glamorous and the pay is in the Choir's own coin, which spends better than it sounds.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.f2ce0240891: Her last inspection before the loss is a matter of record. It reads like a warning and a eulogy. Whatever the hull is now, it was loved in paperwork once.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.f3c43ed0d6b: They say every hull has a note. Yours rang at the vigil last night — something resolved, something owed. The Choir thanks you for the verse.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.fbd6b01ad32: A manifest with blank pages is a blank check on your hull. If Quinn offers you the unlisted run, ask her who insured the last pilot. Then order something expensive.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.fde1d7a2f39: We pay pilots to reach wrecks before the seagulls do — honest salvage assessment, photographed and filed. Your survival rate is the qualification.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.fe156b1d8c3: This notification fulfills all legal obligations of notification. Further notifications will be billed at the notifying rate.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.fe341b276e3: Captain Vols kept a ledger of small debts — coffee owed, shifts covered, a hand lent at the gantry. The ledger outlived the crew. Pay it forward or pay it off; the hull remembers either way.
messages.loc.src.data.mail.field.body.fe479e0c264: A bounty was priced and processed on your hull. Processing costs are borne by the processed. Standard practice, itemized attached.
messages.loc.src.data.manifestgame.field.line.1b9: Fills the hold early, then protects the manifest.
messages.loc.src.data.manifestgame.field.line.3a0: Permits first. Holds early when the other column is weaker.
messages.loc.src.data.manifestgame.field.line.8be: Keeps a bribe ready and risks the heavy load.
messages.loc.src.data.manifestgame.field.line.f50: Audits an unsealed load before adding cargo.
messages.loc.src.data.manifestgame.field.line.fc6: Pushes the last tonne. You can make him overfill.
messages.loc.src.data.missionconditions.field.bri: If the wreck wakes, hunt it.
Sling an anchor clean, deliver early and under control.
Cracks cost the premium; the survivors still pay.
If the pods are bait, clear the field.
If the escort turns, hunt them.
Do not let the line go slack.
Do not blow or break your cloak.
If the buyer is the law, reroute.
If the cargo cooks, recover it.
messages.loc.src.data.missionconditions.field.pro: This hull may still have a crew. Wake it and the salvage becomes a hunt — the wreck stays the reason to be here.
The distress may be an ambush. Close on the pods and the rescue becomes a field-clear — the pods stay in the picture.
Land one solid mass strike on this job — a rock, a wreck, anything with weight behind it.
This lot can cook mid-run. If it slams, the job becomes a recovery — not a voided manifest.
This freight does not survive a hard knock. Crack any of it and the contract is void.

Know the local geometry: sling an anchor and let go clean on the Massline, then brake honest and run out under control to the berth well inside the window. Early slung deliveries earn a punctuality premium on top of base pay.
The drop may be a sting. Come in close and the contract reroutes — you still have a buyer, just not this one.
This convoy may show its real colours mid-run. If they turn, the job becomes a hunt — it does not die in a red box.
Come into the destination quiet — no sustained burn above {QUIET_APPROACH_SPEED} wu/s inside {QUIET_APPROACH_RANGE_WU} wu of it.
Crack something big enough to leave a core chunk behind. That is what the refinery is short of.
Once you are on the load, keep the line working. Three seconds of slack forfeits the recovery premium.
The buyer is paying for technique: land three vent bonuses while you fill this.
Keep your cloak discipline intact on this run — do not let the cloak blow out or break under fire.
Show them the line works: one clean or razor release logged before you file this.
Never exceed {STEADY_SPEED_LIMIT} wu/s while the manifest is aboard. The premium is paid on a calm run.
Freight priced by the unit on arrival. A hard knock costs the handling premium and whatever cracked — the rest still settles.
Match the berth before you hand over: inside {BERTH_RANGE_WU} wu of the destination and under {BERTH_SPEED} wu/s.
Finish at least one of them with a thrown mass, not a gun.
Run this one without firing. Shove, tow and outfly — but do not shoot.

messages.loc.src.data.missions.field.brief.662c65: A 200-mass core. Fit a frame coupler (shipworks, Tractor Systems) or fight the pendulum in.

messages.loc.src.data.modules.field.description.0: A polarized scanner gasket tuned to the membrane band. Mirror-echo contacts mark themselves instead of wearing a clean return.
messages.loc.src.data.modules.field.description.1: A pylon projector and two pairs of deployable endpoints. Each endpoint is a body that hostile fire can destroy; the wall between a linked pair stops hostile hulls, shots, beams, blasts and arcs while you and your allies cross it both ways. Strain it too hard and it overloads; lose an endpoint and it collapses.
messages.loc.src.data.modules.field.description.2: A slow tape for the relay band. Sites that pulse in phase leave a coherence signature in your flight log.
messages.loc.src.data.modules.field.description.3: A lattice-tuned responder salvaged from a machine site. Verge instruments read your compliance in half the window.
messages.loc.src.data.modules.field.description.4: Electrostatic mesh over the intakes and plate seams. Contaminated sectors stop fouling your hull — and your manifest.
A sealed custody drawer rated for living cargo. What is locked in it does not breathe on the manifest.
messages.loc.src.data.modules.field.description.5: A hull-resonance mapper that reads the structure under the growth. Entering a colonized field, the host resolves on the chart.
A padded field cage for the massline. Release the latch while it is fitted and the animal comes aboard alive.
messages.loc.src.data.modules.field.description.6: A rack listener on the relay band. Inside a colonized field it reports how coherent the ecology currently reads.
Fit it and Pull drops a collector: the well binds loose rocks and wrecks into one knot at its maw. Hold Pull to aim the knot, release to throw it from where it sits.
messages.loc.src.data.modules.field.description.7: A field coil salvaged from a dead pylon. Your beam strikes read as dead matter — the sleepers do not hear you work.
messages.loc.src.data.modules.field.description.b: A tuned probe for the relay band. Coherent emitters report their broadcast strength instead of a bare contact.
Charge-thrown bait: a burn-flag beacon that reads hotter than your reactor. Predators chase the lie for a minute.
A two-pin tap into site memory. Approach a machine site and its last issued directive echoes back through your comms.
messages.loc.src.data.modules.field.description.c: A burn collar around the plate seams. Docking with it fitted fires one sterilizing pass — fouled hulls berth clean.
messages.loc.src.data.modules.field.description.d: Deep-sector rated filters — a full-bore regeneration stack for pilots who work contaminated space on purpose.
Hull plating that damps your drive and mass signature. Animals that hunt heat notice you later — or never.
Registry-stamped quarantine seals. Stations that would refuse a biological lot instead take it at surrender prices.
A Verge-layer decode lattice. Where the machines speak in directive fragments, you read the sentence underneath.
messages.loc.src.data.modules.field.description.e: A scanning head retuned for filament-band returns. Biological contacts resolve one classification rung earlier.
messages.loc.src.data.modules.field.description.f: Brake and throw to drop a proximity charge behind your flight path; a plain throw still sticks a plate. Pursuers trigger a radial shove; remote detonation still works.
messages.loc.src.data.moraltraps.field.blurb.1f9e: The station gets useless cargo. You keep the pay — but the Frontier remembers.
messages.loc.src.data.moraltraps.field.blurb.260e: Arms reach their buyer. You keep the pay — and a quiet faction's approval.
messages.loc.src.data.moraltraps.field.blurb.2dc2: You ferry them to safety. Frontier goodwill — and Concord heat if scanned.
messages.loc.src.data.moraltraps.field.blurb.5fd2: The Pit pays twice for its own air. You keep the margin. Meridian’s Clear-Air position widens.
messages.loc.src.data.moraltraps.field.blurb.6739: Jettison the fakes, name the supplier. You lose the pay but the relief effort lives.
messages.loc.src.data.moraltraps.field.blurb.7120: Hand the canisters to the station they were stolen from. No pay. The Pit breathes one cycle longer.
messages.loc.src.data.moraltraps.field.blurb.8e83: Hand the arms to a Concord patrol. You lose the pay but earn lawful standing.
messages.loc.src.data.moraltraps.field.blurb.ccc0: Strip the moisture-loss line and log the two by name. The ore contract is broken. The dead leave the column.
messages.loc.src.data.moraltraps.field.blurb.e53e: Turn them in for the bounty. Credits now — and a name the Frontier won't forget.
messages.loc.src.data.moraltraps.field.blurb.fc84: The moisture-loss column stands. The two stay filed as tonnes. Drift remembers, and so does the ledger.
messages.loc.src.data.moraltraps.field.prompt.17f: Your passenger is a wanted fugitive. What do you do?
messages.loc.src.data.moraltraps.field.prompt.1b0: The cargo is weapons, not equipment. What do you do?
messages.loc.src.data.moraltraps.field.prompt.390: The cargo is the cover for two dead miners. What do you do?
messages.loc.src.data.moraltraps.field.prompt.8ac: The air was stolen from the people waiting for it. What do you do?
messages.loc.src.data.moraltraps.field.prompt.920: The medicine is counterfeit. What do you do?
messages.loc.src.data.mothlight.field.line.9a379c: The six-petal iris is the real gun. The little lights only drift.
messages.loc.src.data.narrative.field.hint.04b9b4: Deep Reach operation, then Ashfall desk. Ledger COUNTERPARTY: your prior transponder; Elroy DECEASED (B2). Five dispositions — not a title.
messages.loc.src.data.narrative.field.hint.37f01f: Eliminate the hostile. The tag will read UNKNOWN before, THREAT NEUTRALIZED after. There is a third tag, briefly. You may not catch it.
messages.loc.src.data.narrative.field.hint.3afbec: The communicator still carries a coordinate file. The registry cross-check returns NO MATCH. That is also normal.
messages.loc.src.data.narrative.field.hint.594a81: Haul the components. The manifest will say INDUSTRIAL COMPONENTS. At destination it will say SURPLUS REDISTRIBUTION. Nobody will flag the change. This is normal.
messages.loc.src.data.narrative.field.hint.acd812: Three intro contracts, one clearing station. The administrator field reads V. DIRECTOR, ACTING. All three sides run through the same administrator.
messages.loc.src.data.narrative.field.hint.cb05f7: Contract 47-A. Mass on accept: 12.4t. Authorization: VALE, D. / REF 44-C. Sample the discrepancy. Deliver Helios. Payment withheld.
messages.loc.src.data.narrative.field.hint.e46470: Deploy first asset. First remittance line: CLEARED — VALE HOLDINGS LLC.
messages.loc.src.data.narrative.field.hint.ee703c: Buy a bigger hull. A ship at the yard is named VARIANCE ADJUSTMENT. That is Kessler\u2019s terminology. Someone who worked the scales named it before they sold it.
messages.loc.src.data.narrative.field.hint.feac7f: Complete the chain. One target vessel\u2019s last registered owner is VALE HOLDINGS LLC. The salvage manifest you deliver will read ADMINISTRATIVE RECORDS \u2014 3 YEARS / SEALED.
messages.loc.src.data.narrative.field.summary.117: Available only if you took the administrator\u2019s ledger and have not jettisoned it. Stay. Take the desk. Watch, record, stay.
messages.loc.src.data.narrative.field.summary.275: Identity disappears from public records. Name stops appearing on boards. ROUTING OVERSIGHT jobs unlock — logistics only, no direct action. The cut arrives automatically.
messages.loc.src.data.narrative.field.summary.41d: No contract. A graffiti line. Fly to Ashfall Reach with full load, no active contracts, initiate jump-drive charge toward the wormhole with no destination registered.
messages.loc.src.data.narrative.field.summary.563: Decline all four (A, B, C, D). Approach the Ashfall Reach station one final time. A courier who was not there before says the line. Accept the payout for 47-A: +1,200cr. Status: CLOSED. Immediately: CONTRACT 47-B: STATUS: PENDING.
messages.loc.src.data.narrative.field.summary.67d: Concord rep → +700 (Hero). Criminal record cleared. Station surcharges gone. The HUD stabilizes — clean tags, accurate IFF. Everything looks clean.
messages.loc.src.data.narrative.field.summary.6bf: Mass on accept: 12.4t. Authorization: VALE, D. / REF 44-C. Sample the discrepancy. Deliver to Helios Station.

messages.loc.src.data.narrative.field.text.5d1bdc: That's the 7741 ship. Keep your fees current and we won't have a problem.

messages.loc.src.data.narrative.field.text.6fbb95: TO: SLATE / PIT SHIPYARD / RE: BERTH 4 / WE KNOW WHICH SEAM.
messages.loc.src.data.narrative.field.text.7046a5: She's yours. Don't ask what happened to the last crew. I mean it.
messages.loc.src.data.narrative.field.text.72e85e: KESSLER: YOUR DISCREPANCY CLOSED ITSELF. SIGNATURE ON FILE: VALE, D. NO ACTION REQUIRED FROM YOU.

messages.loc.src.data.narrative.field.text.99c8a3: ATMO TOKENS — SECTOR 0 BID RAISED 0.4. SECTOR 6 BID RAISED 0.6. POSITION HELD. NEXT CLEAR IN 12 CYCLES.

messages.loc.src.data.narrative.field.text.e770d2: Next berth: Helios Station. Kessler at the cargo desk has Contract 47-A if you hauled, fought, or pulled salvage.

messages.loc.src.data.newgamedefaults.field.blurb: Fast strike interceptor. High acceleration and dual offensive mounts.
Industrial hauler. Heavy-duty winch and dual mining lasers.
Light on the line. Quick to bank. Responsive tether agility.
Dual ballistic weapons and a reinforced ram plate with rapid acceleration. Built for aggressive bounties and fast skirmishes. The ram plate is second-hand — the original is still on someone else's hull.
Reinforced frame with dual mining lasers, heavy winch, and expanded cargo holds. Built for deep salvage and bulk hauling. The winch drum still carries the score marks from the tow that bought her.

Light and nimble chassis with versatile starter outfitting. Balanced for salvage, mining, or dogfighting. The deck plate under the pilot seat is replacement stock — the first one went out with the crew before yours.

messages.loc.src.data.pallashiddencache.field.det: The pirate wreck still carries a physical manifest fragment. Investigate it to recover an approximate Pallas search patch.
A sealed weapons mass sits inside the debris. Investigate the physical cache before choosing its disposition.
messages.loc.src.data.pallasworkshift.field.label: SKER RUN UNDER THREAT
Our crew is avoiding danger. The passage is on hold; keep clear of the fleeing hulls.
messages.loc.src.data.palletjack.field.line.0b797: Pallet Jack is reaching for loose freight. Move the load or break its front clamp.
messages.loc.src.data.phoebepracticeconnection.fi: Your five-note chime phrase still holds. You can return to hear it; the tuning fee is not paid again.
CB-9 is gone. The chime crystals keep their own time; there is no tuner to judge a new phrase.
CB-9 tends five chime crystals. Strike them in the right order and follow the tuner’s calls; a wrong note restarts the phrase.
CB-9 remembers {count} of five notes in your current phrase. Continue with the next crystal; a wrong note restarts the phrase.
you put a mate in a tumble
the law broke up the take

messages.loc.src.data.poibehaviorfamilies.field.e: Industrial traffic inbound. Match vector or clear the lane.
Raider claim ahead. Read the warning before committing.
Active seam. Work clean and clear the haul lane.
Research signal unstable. Triangulate before closing range.
Licensed yard. Hold vector for traffic control.
Cold hull. Scan first; salvage only what answers.
Dead orbital telemetry. Sound the well from three ranges.
messages.loc.src.data.poibehaviorfamilies.field.o: See one convoy through the lane.
Break two hostile actors after engagement is authorized.
Take scan soundings from three distinct ranges of the well.
Scan from three distinct local bearings.
Dock cleanly inside local traffic control.
Recover three registered yields from the field.
messages.loc.src.data.postendingreplaychains.fiel: A blind response turns a traffic complaint into collective punishment.
The route moved, but the missing receipt leaves payment and cause unresolved.
The erased loss merges with the field and the desk fails its witness.
The clerk is indexed and the quiet channel acquires a public owner.
A chart without a physical sample remains an untested frontier story.
Without the chips, 47-B becomes another allegation without custody.
The badge protects paper while civilian route capacity burns.
A one-way delivery is charity, not a durable frontier route.
Without a second region the recurrence remains a story, not a measurement.
A scan makes the timing edge public before the route can exploit it.
The broker vanishes with the only buyer list for the recurrence.
The uncharted pockets remain rumor and navigational danger.
The proposed civilian route fails its first practical load.
Without testimony the escort becomes another unverifiable patrol claim.
Publication without inspection becomes another remote administrative claim.
An unverified shelter trail can hide either safety or another disappearance.
The replacement manifest closes without a surviving comparison load.
A lost extract lets the institution deny that the erased crew existed.
Lost receipts leave the relief route vulnerable to tracing and extortion.
Duplicated keys turn your channel into a pirate toll map.
The open route begins without a witness or a chart.
The carrier loss turns the ignored discrepancy into a route shortage.
Dione loses the relief lot and the channel becomes an empty abstraction.
Lost calibration leaves the loop private and unverifiable.
The recurrence decays into ordinary Ashfall noise.
The black route becomes evidence tied to the identity you erased.
A sanction without evidence becomes indistinguishable from confiscation.
The discrepancy enters the ledger as acceptable transit loss.
The failed sanction emboldens the marked cell and frightens neutral carriers.
The witness disappears and the private archive becomes hearsay.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.blurb.1b71: The reef shoves on surge and goes quiet on calm. Cross the mine string on the window, not on nerve.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.blurb.3b7b: Two foundry windows on the same clock. The belt gathers you; the storm sheet carries you.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.blurb.49a3: A ribbon through the wash. The burn ring sits in the radiation pocket. The gas is the scenery you already chart.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.blurb.86f6: The sluice exhausts downstream on surge and goes quiet on calm. Three crossings, one clock.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.blurb.9669: The count plaza is the first half. The buoys are the ones already on the inbound lane.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.blurb.bca7: Gate-camp rock on both approaches. The banks are the checkpoints and the hazard at once.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.blurb.bf12: A closed lap through the starter claim and the outer metallic rocks. The belt is the course.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.blurb.c409: The glow eats the east descent. The debris field takes the north arc. Neither one moves for you.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.blurb.ef4d: Dense ice all through the north arc, and the drill works the fissure on its own cycle.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.brief.14ee: One lap of the Sker approaches. Both banks are the checkpoints and the hazard; the posted purse says the Reach approves.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.brief.1752: Three laps of the wash. The gas eats a top-down frame. The radiation pocket is a burn ring. Leave the ribbon and the leash drags you back.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.brief.4300: Customs cooked the overhead picture on the tally. Approach within 70 WU of the line at 8 WU/s or less, align with the first leg and release any tether; fly the course, then dock at the destination station to file.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.brief.5c78: One lap of the Pallas reef. The current shoves on surge and goes quiet on calm — the pilot who reads the window keeps the line.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.brief.5e88: A pace light traces the tally ahead of you. Read its line through the turns; real rivals provide the draft in pack races. The stern camera stays on — that is how dispatch watches the run.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.brief.8685: One lap of the Vesta furnace circuit. The belt gathers and the storm sheet carries, both on the same shift clock.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.brief.b390: The dispatch clerk who graded Vesper’s mark disputes the lap. Two circuits of the belt, posted purse, stern camera — he is watching the same rocks you are.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.brief.df95: Helios dispatch grades one lap of the belt from a stern camera. Overhead optics are not the instrument they pay for.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.brief.f4c3: The belt mark is already posted. Beat the tightened clock. The rocks do not rearrange themselves.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.hint.192bd: The east disc takes the Throne pass. Do not improvise inside it.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.hint.2a580: The drill throws on surge. Pass the shoulder on calm.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.hint.2e7a7: Old-war mass fills the north arc. The banks mark the only line through.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.hint.33101: The disc is rock all the way through. Stay on the cleared line.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.hint.45c80: The belt gathers on surge. Wait the calm or spend the crossing fast.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.hint.50b72: The cone shoves downstream on surge. Time the calm; the site keeps its own clock.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.hint.9c7d7: The west disc is crowded with scrap rock. Hold the cleared lane.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.hint.a13d2: The glow covers the descent. Short exposure, clean line, no sightseeing.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.hint.b23b1: The sheet carries everything inside it. Enter on the calm or ride it straight.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.hint.cd088: The reef pushes on surge; the calm window is the crossing.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.summary.35: One lap of the Pallas reef. Stern camera required. The surge is the course.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.summary.3e: One lap through both Helios fields. The stern camera is required.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.summary.49: Same Helios terrain as qualifying. Stern camera. Tighter time bands.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.summary.66: Stop and align at the start line (within 70 WU, at 8 WU/s or less, no tether), run the tally, then dock at the destination station. Chase view during countdown and course.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.summary.96: The tally circuit again. Follow the pace light through the turns. Stern camera required.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.summary.a8: Two laps of the Helios belt. Stern camera required. The clerk is grading this one personally.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.summary.c2: Three laps on the Veil wash. Stern camera required. Burn ring in the radiation pocket.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.summary.d5: One lap of the Sker wreckrun. Stern camera required. Dense rock on both approaches.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.summary.e6: One lap of the Vesta furnace. Stern camera required. Two hazard windows.
messages.loc.src.data.racelevels.field.summary.f6: Practice. The stern camera follows your steering-view setting; it is not locked.
Reef surge crossing and ice return
messages.loc.src.data.racingloadouts.field.descri: Long straights; brake earlier for turns.
messages.loc.src.data.reactivematter.configuratio: An elastic pad stops a hauler and only nudges the player
Reel an elastic pod into a bumper, then cut so the snap throws the puck
Cut the massline and the crane takes the crate
Wait for traffic to open the cryo gate, then thrust through the gap
Traffic breaks a cryo spar; the tow does not duplicate shards
A heat lane and a hauler cook a volatile convoy inside the reaction budget
Reel a volatile canister out of a thermal field before it cooks
A crane flips polarity and sweeps ferromagnetic debris
Haul the ferromagnetic crate out of a crane well
Tow a volatile canister off a traffic lane before the hauler arrives
A thermal field fractures a towed cryo spar and the hitch retargets
Reel a ferromagnetic volatile can clear of a hot crane housing
Traffic piles elastic pods into a volatile neighbor; the cascade stays bounded
Keep the massline; a cryo spar fracture retargets onto the surviving lug
Fly away with the latched ferromagnetic crate; the free one rides its crane
