messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.029: An unmarked hull paid cash and left before the receipt printed. Standard.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.032: THE PIT OWES US NOTHING. WE TAKE IT ANYWAY.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.048: Manifest corrections close before the market does. The market never does.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.066: THE MACHINES LEFT DOORS. WE KEEP THE KEYS. KNOCK POLITELY.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.07b: THE SHORT ROUTE IS CHARGED AS THE LONG ONE. ASK ANYTHING.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.0d9: A crate of unclaimed mail waits at the column. The clerk is patient.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.0eb: Undock queue is posted in order received. Asking moves you to the back.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.132: BORN IN THE PIT. DIED ON YOUR LEDGER. STILL HERE.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.139: THE WEAK PAY TOLLS. THE STRONG COLLECT THEM. CHOOSE A SIDE OF THE LEDGER.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.140: EVERY TONNE MOVES. EVERY TONNE IS COUNTED. MOVE WITH THE COUNT.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.14f: YOUR HULL, YOUR RULES. PAY YOUR CREWS AND KEEP MOVING.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.15f: DEPENDENTS MUST BE DECLARED BEFORE THEY ARE DEPENDENT.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.182: EVERY STATION HAS A FLOOR BELOW THE FLOOR. WE KEEP THE LIGHTS ON DOWN THERE.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.1a1: Weapons stay safed and slaved inside the ring. The tower counts muzzles.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.1ae: The market board flickers but the numbers hold. The board denies flickering.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.1b3: THE LANE IS PATROLLED BECAUSE THE LANE IS YOURS. FLY QUIET AND LEGAL.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.1fc: IMPROVEMENT IS MEASURABLE. SUBMIT TO MEASUREMENT.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.258: Spot prices print at the bell. Verbal quotes are wishes.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.2a6: A conscience in a taped evidence bag has been at the column since last rotation. It is being processed.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.2db: YOUR MANIFEST IS YOUR OWN. KEEP IT THAT WAY.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.308: Tailings drift is a navigation hazard, not a filing error. Fly the corridor.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.309: Transponder on. IFF current. Visitors without clearances berth at the far cradle.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.32a: Dockside prayer wheel turns again. The Choir asks that you not lean on it.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.330: THE TIDE TAKES WHAT THE TIDE IS OWED. SAIL WITH IT, NOT AGAINST IT.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.33b: The air plant hit quota early. Breathing remains subsidized.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.34f: OPEN CLAIM — the {hull} {callsign}. {tier} warrant. Finders collect in person.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.3ff: Pallet seals are checked at the door, not at the berth. Plan accordingly.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.404: WE READ THE DARK BETTER THAN YOUR CHARTS. ASK US FIRST.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.49f: NO FLAG, NO DEBTS. ONLY THE REACH AND THE TAKING.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.4a3: Casting runs mark the bay. Expect thermal bloom on approach.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.4c8: Ore tallies are weighed wet. Everyone dries the same.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.4cc: A crate marked HANDLE WITH CARE has been at the column since Tuesday. It is being handled.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.4e2: Dock control reminds inbound traffic that the queue is not a rumor.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.4e3: WHAT IS WRITTEN SURVIVES THE WRITER. CONTRIBUTE YOUR RECORD.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.500: Claim disputes settle at the survey, not the shaft. Paper first, charges second.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.514: SATISFACTION IS A ROUTE. WE RUN IT ON SCHEDULE.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.5c3: YOUR WRECK HAS VALUE. SO DOES YOUR ARRIVAL.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.600: A SEALED HOLD IS A PROMISE. PROMISES ARE AUDITED.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.603: DISPUTES SETTLE FASTER WHEN BOTH PARTIES PAY UPFRONT.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.60c: Berth fees hold steady this rotation. Dock office cites routine.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.64a: FORGETTING IS A SERVICE OUTAGE. THE ARCHIVE STAYS UP.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.67c: HOT MEAL. COLD TRAY. WARM LEDGER.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.680: Crew rotation at the bell. Idle hands will be assigned.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.6b7: HEDGE YOUR HAUL. THE MARKET ALREADY BET AGAINST YOU.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.6d5: Gantry crew reports one near-miss and zero admissions. Filed as routine.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.6d9: SAY NOTHING, CARRY EVERYTHING. THE QUIET REMEMBERS WHO PAID.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.6e9: Freight insurance renewals climb again. Actuaries decline to celebrate.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.709: Notices older than one rotation are binding regardless of readership.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.731: Open flame requires a permit, a spotter, and a better idea.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.781: EVERY MANIFEST IS FOREVER. WRITE A GOOD ONE.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.82c: WORMALD AND SONS VACUUMS. BAY NINE. OUR SUCTION SCHEMATICS HAVE BEEN CLASSIFIED TWICE.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.83d: A patrol flight returned with every hull it left with. Noted, not praised.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.853: Unmanifested mass stays on the apron. Disputes go to the scale, not the crew.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.87f: WE HOLD WHAT YOU CANNOT AFFORD TO LOSE.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.8c2: Shore power draws are metered. The meter is also audited.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.8c5: The bar extends hours at the bell. Management denies a connection.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.8c9: THE LEDGER DOES NOT LIE. PEOPLE LIE TO THE LEDGER.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.954: What the scale says is what you carried. What you carried is your business.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.959: Berth assignments hold for one shift. Extensions cost more than apologies.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.95b: YOUR DOCKING BOND EARNS INTEREST. FOR US.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.966: A REGISTERED HULL IS A PROTECTED HULL. REGISTER BEFORE YOU NEED PROTECTING.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.99d: NO MASTERS, NO MANIFESTS, NO MERCY FOR TOLL-TAKERS. THE FRONTIER STAYS FREE.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.9ca: No manifest window. No manifest line. Keep your credits where your eyes are.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.9e0: THE BODY IS A PROTOTYPE. THE DIRECTORATE SHIPS REVISIONS.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.9ee: The lamplighters finished their wiring ahead of schedule. Surveillance remains a courtesy.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.a31: O-RINGS, SEALS, AND THE OCCASIONAL MIRACLE. STOCK VARIES.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.a32: MAPS SOLD AS SURVEYED. THE SURVEY SOLD AS IS.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.a3e: ACCIDENTS ARE REPORTED IN THE ORDER THEY ARE PAID.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.a5d: YOU WERE CARRIED HERE BY HANDS YOU NEVER SAW. TIP THEM ANYWAY.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.a63: A CLAIM IS A PROMISE TO THE BELT. KEEP IT AND THE BELT KEEPS YOU.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.a69: Transfer gantry cycling. Keep limbs inside the painted lines.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.a72: Do not power the main drive inside the cradle. The clamps remember.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.a77: EVERY HULL HAS A NOTE. THE CHOIR TEACHES IT TO SING.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.a84: WANTED — the {hull} {callsign}. {tier} warrant outstanding. Report sightings; do not approach.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.ac3: LANE COURTESY IS MANDATORY. FRIENDLINESS IS BILLABLE.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.b36: A long-haul skipper swore the lane sang back. The wire prints it anyway.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.b3c: Bay atmosphere is recycled courtesy. Thank the previous tenant.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.b4e: IMPOUND IS A STORAGE SOLUTION WITH A PAPERWORK PREMIUM.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.b7b: THE ROCK BELONGS TO THE CREW THAT BREAKS IT. CLOCK IN AND SWING.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.bfa: NOTICE OF WARRANT — {callsign}, registered {hull}. Charges pending review. Surrender preserves the hull.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.c07: SECURITY POSTING — the {hull} {callsign} is wanted under a {tier} warrant. Berth crews report contact.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.c10: Missing-person filings hold at seasonal average. The board keeps the names.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.c8e: WE INSURE THE CRATE. THE CONTENTS ARE A CONVERSATION.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.cb7: EVERY GATE HAS A PRICE AND A QUESTION. ANSWER BOTH.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.ce1: Module cradles rotate on schedule. Berth crews do not rotate the cradles.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.ce4: WORK IS THE FIRST VERSE. COME HEAR THE REST AT THE VIGIL.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.cec: Samples sign in at the airlock. Anything that signs back is quarantine.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.d30: Second watch reports to the transfer gallery. First watch reports to the bar.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.d3d: CURFEW IS A SERVICE WINDOW. COMPLY AND BE SERVICED.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.dc3: The deck plate under berth four is honest today. Walk normally.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.de9: The ore scale passed inspection. The inspector was weighed first.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.e40: Shift rotation proceeds without incident. Supervisors call it a record.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.e50: STASIS IS A SUBSCRIPTION. CANCELLATION REQUIRES NOTICE.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.e81: Shift bell runs on station time, not ship time. No exceptions posted.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.e8a: AN UNFILED HULL IS AN UNOWNED HULL. FILE OR BE FILED.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.f1d: Survey crews report the rocks are where the charts left them. A good week.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.f26: THE BELT PROVIDES. THE BELT ITEMIZES.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.f37: Vent cycles run hot at the hour. Gantries clear during the flare.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.f72: Telemetry sweeps blind the low band on the mark. Keep your instruments humble.
messages.loc.src.data.stationsigns.field.text.fc8: Patch work carries no warranty past the airlock. Neither do you.
messages.loc.src.data.storyrewardbuyers.field.lab: Sell the Lost Ledger back to Meridian
Make the Quadrille corridor count public
Give the Lost Ledger to the Frontier press
File the Lost Ledger with Concord
messages.loc.src.data.storyrewardbuyers.field.lin: Nobody pays for a ledger like that. Everybody reads one.
You have a ledger we have no record of. We would like to keep it that way.
A list of names has a price. I pay it, and nobody ever reads the list.
The Quadrille corridor count. Families have waited a long time to read those names.
If that is the Silver-Draft ledger, it is evidence. Evidence gets a docket number.
messages.loc.src.data.survivalacts.field.question: Six identical lights on one bearing. Throw them into each other before they close.
A tether on the far end is pulling your line. Rope it so the well moves with you.
The second pack arrives behind you. Shove the rear so you can turn.
messages.loc.src.data.survivaldraft.field.blurb.0: Marks a hull so the well pulls that one, not whoever is nearest.
messages.loc.src.data.survivaldraft.field.blurb.3: A held beam. Damage while you keep the line.
A turret that answers incoming fire, not the hull that fired it.
messages.loc.src.data.survivaldraft.field.blurb.4: Slow plasma that leaves a hull cooking after the shot.
messages.loc.src.data.survivaldraft.field.blurb.a: Latches a hull to your frame. Where you go, it follows.
messages.loc.src.data.survivaldraft.field.blurb.b: A bigger energy repeater. Fast and cheap on heat.
messages.loc.src.data.survivaldraft.field.blurb.c: A mine that shoves everything out of a lane, including you.
messages.loc.src.data.survivaldraft.field.blurb.d: Takes a pilot's steering. It drifts and cannot hold a line.
Couples through shields. Sensors and guns go dark first.
messages.loc.src.data.survivaldraft.field.blurb.e: A flat slug that goes through armour rather than around it.
A light kinetic repeater for a small hardpoint.
Throws a light hull into the wall — the wall gets the kill.
messages.loc.src.data.survivaldraft.field.blurb.f: Guided shots that turn after a target you stopped pointing at.
messages.loc.src.data.survivalevolutions.field.bl: The extra bolt and the wide fan become one split on the first hit. The loose volley is gone.
A maxed pulse laser, the twin mount, and the piercing core become one herald fan. The gun stays bolted. The two rigs are spent.
Thrown charges and the decoy buoy become charges you can kick behind you.
A maxed barrage, the targeting computer, and the seeking bank become one triad mount. The rack stays bolted. The two rigs are spent.
The bumper feeds the tractor: same haul, a longer reach. The burst is spent.
The sweep and the snare become one bridle. The two separate lines are spent.
The heat lure and the sink become one point-defense servo. The two loose fittings are spent.
The short bumper and the ram plate become one longer gravity burst. The separate ram is gone.
The sprint drive and the endurance drive become one fusion drive. You stop carrying both.
The heavy winch and the short catch become one longer grip. The faster reel is spent.
The monofilament and the charge rack become one line. The cuts carry a kick.
Banked shots storm through conductive hulls. The pack kills itself.
The afterburner and the ram plate become one part. The burst is the hit.
The springy line and the heavy winch become one faster reel. The loose winch is spent.
The burn payload and the short lance become one longer lance. Shots no longer set their own fires.
messages.loc.src.data.survivalmutators.field.blur: Shots bounce off rock. The reef is a firing angle.
The launch hull is locked for the run.
The launch gun is the only gun. Drafts auto-resolve empty.
Drafts may only offer throw / tag / bind / mine / unsteer.
Guns stay in the rack. The whip is the kit.
The room carries ballast — dead hulls where the rocks should be. Throw what is already broken.
No additional weapons are drafted. The launch gun is the gun.
The room is rock. Bank every shot off the reef.
Hitch in, Hitch out. The hull cannot be swapped.
The room runs the alternating shutter law for every wave the planner will honour.
The paid re-roll is refused. The first three cards stand.
No wasps. Throw the heavies into the wall — Hitch cannot carry the concussion slug.
Mid-run weapon offers auto-resolve empty. The starting kit is the kit.
The Foundry conveyor pulses downstream. Carry threats into the bank plates, or fight from the quiet sides. No rig required.
Three wells. Tag a hull and thread it through. Sitting still is a trap.
Mark a hull so the three wells eat it. Hitch threads; sitting still is a trap.
A concussion slug puts a heavy into the wall. Hitch cannot carry this gun.
Guns stay in the rack. The rope is the kit.
messages.loc.src.data.survivalmutators.field.labe: A room with a different law
messages.loc.src.data.survivalunlocks.field.blurb: The gun you launch is the gun you finish. Drafts do not add a second verb.
A plain autocannon. Always available, so a first run can just shoot.
The three cards you are dealt are the three cards you keep.
A mark for finishing the authored arc. No combat effect.
The nimble, slow Hornet. Same gun, different bells.
The room comes littered with dead hulls. They throw like everything else.
A plain pulse. Always available, so a first run can just shoot.
The hull you launch is the hull you finish. Hitch stays Hitch.
One pulse gun with Bank Shot and Smart Bank. Always available, so a first run can learn the bank.
A note that you finished the authored thirty. No combat effect.
Start on the rope hull.
No mid-run weapon offers. A control ruleset, not a stronger kit.
Start already holding the web.
Drafts may only offer throw / tag / bind / mine / unsteer. A narrower pool, not a bigger gun.
The fast, clumsy Hornet. Same gun, different drive.
The Foundry shutters run the alternating cadence for the whole arc. Same seed, a different room.
Five champions, one after another. No drafts between them.
A physical banking sortie with one real bomb and a certified phase return. Always available.
The public kit. Bank a stream, shove the pack, boost through.
Start already holding tag and bind.
A note that you reached the second act. No combat effect.
A phase jump that spends the boost capacitor. Always available, so the first run can cross a fight.
Hold Boost at a live hostile and release a real charged dash. Contacts resolve through normal physics and combat.

messages.loc.src.data.survivalwaves.field.questio: Screens cover the pack, lances punish holding still, raiders punish tunnel vision. Well the cluster first.
Shooters leave after every shot while the choir fills the lane. Well the choir so they share one hole.
Cross the Foreman's committed pass and punish its slow turn. Throw the escort screen into its hull.
A screen covers the champion. Well the cluster so they share one hole.
The second pack arrives behind you. Shove the rear so you can turn.
You are surrounded. Shove a hole and keep it.
The ace is behind the chaff. Throw mass into it rather than grinding the swarm.
{problem_question} {room_clause}
A tether on the far end is pulling your line. Rope it so the well moves with you.
A hull that will not shake, a salted wake, chaff from a third door. Shove the miner into the brawler.
Screens steal the plate while the fortress holds. Well the escorts, then throw the hull that matters.
The second seven wear the first seven silhouette and are not the same problem. Well the zealots, not the wasps.
Six identical lights on one bearing. Throw them into each other before they close.
Bare mass on a bearing. Throw a body through the pack, or shoot it down.
Screens cover the pack. Well the screens so they share one hole.
The champion is the hull that matters. Throw mass into it.
Shooters leave after every shot. Close and throw, do not chase.
The wake is salted. Shove the miner into the heavy.
A snare well holds the room. Rope the hull so the well moves.
The champion sits in a snare. Rope the well so it moves.
A slow fortress while escorts refresh behind you. Throw the screen into the dreadnought.

messages.loc.src.data.swarmbrood.field.line.0a1cf: The charger squares up — the line is its committed pass.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmbrood.field.line.1f435: A green haze drifts across the field — it clings to a warm hull.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmbrood.field.line.253b0: The leecher wants your hull — it drags until you shed it.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmbrood.field.line.25d0d: The grazer's shell glints — your guns will only sing off it.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmbrood.field.line.46615: A ribbon rides your wake — it is wrapping the hull.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmbrood.field.line.5b0ad: The bellows is swelling — strike it again and it bursts.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmbrood.field.line.621a6: The mites flock and dive. The room is full of ammunition.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmbrood.field.line.ba465: The cyst's glow brightens as it closes — it is about to burst.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmbrood.field.line.bf65d: A spitter arcs acid — the marker is where it lands.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmbrood.field.message.1f: the base family must unlock at wave 1
messages.loc.src.data.swarmbrood.field.message.99: {family_id} remains whipMult does not widen the whip
messages.loc.src.data.swarmbrood.field.message.b2: the mite is missing — the Brood tier is not landed
messages.loc.src.data.swarmbroodlate.field.line.1: The rock cracks — a burrower is coming out.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmbroodlate.field.line.4: A mirebulb's pitch drags your hull — and the bulb is cooking.
The pox sac is walking — her tide only stops for a blast.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmbroodlate.field.line.6: The splitter cracks — three smaller bodies take its place.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmbroodlate.field.line.7: An ash wisp is alight — your shots pass through the glow.
The brood mother is walking — she is dropping mites.
A keelback has your wake — guns will only sing off the shell.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmbroodlate.field.line.c: A remora rides your wake — it is winding up astern.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmbroodlate.field.line.e: The clutchstone cracks — three mites spill out of the shell.
The undertow holds your wake — the drag is on you until you shed it.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmbroodlate.field.line.f: The rock splits — a gloomcap swells out.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmbroodlate.field.messag: {strain_id} mark band is not a small leader count
commander needs its pack aura and a leader count band
volatile needs a positive blast radius and shove
{family_id} remains whipMult does not widen the whip
{family_id} does not continue the roster clock
Fell the Zone 3 boss — the disc answers at any Adventure shipyard.
Fell the Zone 2 boss — docked yards take a tenth off the service rate for the pilot who proved it.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.012c: A plate over the worst of it, priced by the scar. The weld still does the whole hull.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.0545: Hits mark a hull so the well takes that one.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.0b45: Every shot splits. One trigger pull, two things to hit.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.1a74: Primes a hull so the next hit jumps the gap to its neighbours.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.2101: Ninety credits on the counter. The hull you flew is the hull you finish.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.2370: A hit jumps to the next hull in reach. Tight packs kill themselves.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.26d5: Drives a mass slug through whatever it meets — the shove is the shot.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.3478: Every credited kill shoves nearby bodies outward.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.34c0: Drops an allied turret that fights beside you until the wave clears, then strikes its colors.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.3ce4: A heavier screen between the swarm and your hull.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.4009: Every kill ignites whatever stood close to it — ships and brood alike.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.4060: More thrust under you. The whole fight gets faster.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.4171: +6% gun cycle per coil, stacked to five. A hotter hammer on the same trigger.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.46bd: Cooks a target from the inside until its own fuel joins the fire.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.4b01: A thrown lure the pack cannot resist. It dies like debris when the battery does.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.4ebf: Heat leaves the guns so you can hold the trigger.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.4f7a: Every fifth shot from a fitted gun fires twice — no extra heat, no extra capacitor.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.519c: A ram plate. Flying through something stops being your problem.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.5e24: The shot flies out and carves back through you — a hit each way.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.5e84: Shots carry through the first hull into whatever is behind it.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.6146: Hits freeze a hull stiff so the next blow lands on something that cannot yield.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.6b65: A line you put on a hull and haul.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.6d9f: Launches four escort drones that shoot the pack for the wave and leave with it.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.73bf: A longer sling line. Speed lives in the rope.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.81fb: Every gun grows a second barrel.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.82be: Arena cover throws the pack back like a pinball table. Your own contacts unchanged.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.82eb: One line laid across the lane they are coming down.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.83cd: Anything you throw detonates on its first solid impact, credited to you.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.86b5: Hits keep burning after the shot has gone.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.8b6e: Plants a fixed dome that stops the pack and its shots at the rim while yours leave. Runs on a clock.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.8b91: A sawblade that caroms hull to hull until its edge is spent.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.90f3: The line hauls them to you. You are the winch, not the bait.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.913d: Hits stitch nearby enemies together. Their thrust fights their partners; a shove swings the knot.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.9c11: A cloud that breaks every missile lock behind you at once.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.9c86: A springy line. Latch, stretch, snap them into something solid.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.a27f: A lobbed shell drags the pack into a knot, then pops.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.a42c: Sticks a charge to a hull — you call the moment it goes.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.aaff: Loose rocks lash to your hull and circle it as a shield.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.b0f1: Shots spread as they travel — worse on one, better on eight.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.b475: One pull releases a fan of small missiles; each picks its own hull.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.b94e: A weak gravity well follows your ship and pulls nearby bodies inward.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.bf45: A hard shove on demand. The way out of a closing ring.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.c00f: Impulse charges on the rack — a shove for whatever is on top of you.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.c225: +14 hull per plate, stacked to five. Scrap welded straight onto the frame.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.c265: Your shots bounce off rock. Every wall becomes a firing angle.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.c74a: A fan of plasma bolts for the fights that get close.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.ce1f: Hits bleed into systems, not just plating.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.d1bc: Your guns eat the kill chain: +1% damage per live chain point.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.d481: One Bomb press detonates a room-clearing blast that throws and breaks the pack, never you.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.d505: Paints the aim point, then a beam column lands a real hit and a shove on everything in it.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.e03a: Brake and throw to drop a trap behind your flight path; a plain throw is still your sticky plate. Pursuers trigger a blast that throws the pack into the room.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.e078: A taut line that cuts whatever crosses it.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmdraft.field.blurb.e317: The screen shrugs every flavor of fire, not just one.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmfortify.field.descript: Two linked endpoints arc through the space between them on a bounded cycle.
A finite-magazine cannon picks a nearby hostile and spends real rounds.
A timed outward pulse breaks a dense push before heat forces it to cool.
A fixed well gathers light attackers and loose ordnance into a readable ring.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmmode.field.line.0835e5: The furnace wears a crown. Cross the pass; the whole front half is plate.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmmode.field.line.317d29: Three raider aces, flying as one. One bank catches the wing.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmmode.field.line.39bfe8: The furnace is eating. Rip its radiator plates and feed them back — the cavity only opens to feed.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmmode.field.line.62da7f: A ball of accreted wreck is rolling. Every piece of it is ammunition — the magnet core is the last tear.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmmode.field.line.682c11: Something moved into that hulk. Nodes, armour, bay doors — the largest parts pile outside the Iron Maw.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmmode.field.line.69ae8b: A gutted freighter is birthing wasps. The belly doors are the nest — every door and every wasp is ammunition.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmmode.field.line.70e2c5: A derelict worm works the grave. Cut the middle segment — every piece of it is ammunition.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmmode.field.line.876bc4: The Foreman commits on a bearing. Cross the pass — the prow sheds head-on fire.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmmode.field.line.a27371: A worm works the field. It cannot turn mid-weave — put a rock on the line.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmmode.field.line.b03ca1: Shove the screen. The brawlers are what it was covering.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmmode.field.line.c809b0: The broodmother floods the room. Break her sacs — her own brood is ammunition.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmmode.field.line.cc9c6c: Close while the anchor holds you. The ghosts do not chase.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmmode.field.line.e57b28: The lane is closed for audit. Tear the seal emitters and the clamp — the gate welds shut behind you.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmmode.field.line.f38493: A capital hull is on the field. Throw the pack into the flank berm.

messages.loc.src.data.swarmmode.field.question.34: The anchor bites only when it means it — its own cycle is the opening.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmmode.field.question.7c: One hull commits alone through the loose rock — the room is full of mass that is not yours yet.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmmode.field.question.e4: Something else wants the other end of the line — and the middle of the room is lit.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmperks.field.blurb.322f: Your hull hits like the plated module — collisions deal damage.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmperks.field.blurb.670e: Every kill feeds the boost reserve.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmperks.field.blurb.6e1d: Champions pay three times the run credits.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmperks.field.blurb.90e1: Every tenth kill drops a bonus credit chip.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmperks.field.blurb.97df: Two more re-rolls on the bench — then paid draws at half price.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmperks.field.blurb.9b3a: A kill past chain 25 detonates the body.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmstakes.field.blurb.00d: Nothing but the hull. The purse is what you take off the pack.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmstakes.field.blurb.55e: Walk in rich; the room is a classroom. Buy what you want to see.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmstakes.field.blurb.7bf: The run the swarm was tuned for. A real stake, an honest pack.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmstakes.field.blurb.b23: Thin purse, thick pack. The shop is earned, not spent into.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmthreats.field.blurb.0c: Bursts into two wasps on death.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmthreats.field.blurb.2f: Hardens the hulls flying near it.
The stake purse halves — the armory earns every card.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmthreats.field.blurb.3f: Every hostile hull runs fifteen percent hotter.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmthreats.field.blurb.4a: Explodes on death — chain fuel, rewards throwing.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmthreats.field.blurb.5a: Drags your credit chips off the field.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmthreats.field.blurb.5c: The shelf deals once. What it says is what you fly.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmthreats.field.blurb.71: Champions plate up half again — and affixes ride every wave.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmthreats.field.blurb.7d: No armory between rounds. The launch kit is the kit.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmthreats.field.blurb.8d: Thirty-five percent more bodies in every room.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmthreats.field.blurb.97: Runs a third faster than its kin.
messages.loc.src.data.swarmthreats.field.blurb.b0: A bubble eats the first hits — pop it.

messages.loc.src.data.thebolus.field.body.04679d3: A Charon customs buoy swallowed with the last intake convoy — the casing is acid-etched, the beacon cell still answers on schedule. It reports a lane position inside nothing the chart admits exists. The Rib reads it as proof the gut keeps what it takes.
messages.loc.src.data.thebolus.field.body.3475870: A Meridian hauler swallowed whole and coughed up against the far lip — holds intact, manifest sealed. It lists foreman Ila Vess and crew of six, cargo: seed stock and surgical steel. The Rib\u2019s log says the gut kept it eleven years and decided against digestion. The crew are filed as the manifest\u2019s last entry.
messages.loc.src.data.thebolus.field.body.3996206: The Swallowed Rib\u2019s watch buoy, moored off the berth so the throat can\u2019t close between the station and its own lamp. Station log, shift three: WATCH LIVE. THROAT QUIET. The buoy\u2019s keeper initials it every watch — the only signature in the gut the station insists on.

messages.loc.src.data.wreckcathedralevidencecatal: Clamp scoring and displaced fasteners face outward from the fly-through cavity. The carried device was released from inside the Vigilant rather than torn away by an external collision.
Registry geometry identifies the wreck as the Concord Vigilant despite the missing transponder core. The surviving frame spacing and bridge profile exclude every other hull in the convoy manifest.

The emergency relay clock lost synchronization before the structural breakup recorded by the hull sensors. Whatever stopped the convoy interrupted its coordination channel before it tore the Vigilant apart.
The navigation record terminates inside Ceres without a gate-exit acknowledgment. Its final vectors converge on the split capital hull now catalogued as the Wreck Cathedral.

The recovered black box binds the convoy route, relay clock, and internal release to one custody record. Its final entry identifies a classified archive package, but not the party that ordered the transfer.
messages.loc.src.data.wreckclasses.field.blurb.11: A recent loss — cargo still largely intact, if you reach it before the scavengers.
messages.loc.src.data.wreckclasses.field.blurb.46: A hull parked by its faction berth — consigned, fed, or digested on purpose. Whatever it remembers, the berth keeps it.
messages.loc.src.data.wreckclasses.field.blurb.53: A duplicate Form 7-V moored by the Helix Directorate. Pulling it off the pier opens an audit variance.
messages.loc.src.data.wreckclasses.field.blurb.5d: A sealed reading copy racked by the Archive at Pallas. Removing it from the stacks opens a redaction writ.
messages.loc.src.data.wreckclasses.field.blurb.61: Drifted here long before the lane was charted. Mostly picked clean; the black box may still read.
messages.loc.src.data.wreckclasses.field.blurb.8b: Shot to pieces in a fight the sim recorded here. Salvageable, but hot — cut carefully.
messages.loc.src.data.wreckclasses.field.blurb.95: A Concord-flagged hull. Stripping it without a permit is a crime — Concord fines, the Quiet launders.
messages.loc.src.data.wreckclasses.field.blurb.dc: Scattered hull plating. Slim pickings, but nobody will ask questions.

messages.loc.src.data.wreckmissions.field.summary: Recover the hauler black box whose mass log is the cover for two missing Drift miners. Deliver it — to the buyer who pays, or the one who counts.
A Quiet bounty chip names a bearing, not a face. Hunt the ghost before the contract expires.
Recover the nav core and scan the marked mine drop bearings before another convoy dies in the wake.
Two live pods drift off a fresh wreck with raiders inbound. Pull both pods out from under the raid — or strip the field and leave them.
Tether the drifting Silt canisters out of the wreck field and sell the pressurized air.
A dead hauler drifts with a live sealed core in its cradle. Latch the wreck or sling the core free and drag it to a buyer.
Pull the escort black box so insurers can price PD screens against raider missile racks.
A float of rebreathed air drifts off a wreck — relief stock resold to the station it was taken from. Haul it to a buyer, or back to the people who breathed it first.
The wreck log fingers a specific raider. Track the marked hostile and put them down.
A sealed Choir offering drifts free of a wreck. Deliver it unopened — or open it and live with the Pattern.
Recover an encrypted courier chip for The Quiet. Ask no questions, get paid.
A single survivor drifts in a failing pod. Haul them to safety — or leave the pod for the scrap.

messages.loc.src.story.campaign47a.embodiedmissio: A marked vessel holds station off the Ashfall approach. Scan before firing; the register decides what the wreck is worth.

Accept at Tethys, then fly to Charon: Cinder One, Two and Three hold the Ashfall approach. Clear all three and tow one of their actual hulls to Rook’s 100-WU ring at Expanse, at rest (8 WU/s or less). Either order. Keep a hull intact; if all three are destroyed or stripped, clearance files for no contract pay. Next: the Compost Run.
Sealed manifest. Carry the crate to the receiving station intact; compare the manifest on arrival.
Keep the core on the line into the yard, or sling it in.
Six modules, one frame, and the Nereid gate welding on the road behind you. Tow the homestead together before the line strands it.
A Furnace maw hunts the Ceres reactor approach. Stun it with hot slag — three solid hits — then tow it out of the lane to the yard, or sling it in.
Reach is cutting cargo spines in the Tethys rock field. Escort the Meridian train through and re-couple it under fire — the tickers count each drifting container down.
The Mirrorjaw Foreman holds the yard lane and calls every weld an unpaid debt. Put mass through the plated prow or outgun the stern.
Delivery run for Slate\u2019s yard. Keep the core on the line into the yard, or sling it in — the Hawser seam reads honest: it holds three spikes and lets go at the fourth.

DMC wants four repair-mite sites cleared at the Ceres refinery before the hauler lots are settled. These mites mend wrecks; they are not fighters. Use carefully placed frag blasts, then tow or fling the three marked ore pods into the open CR-FEED ring. Blasts can also kill Casket worms nearby. Buy frag and Load it in Shipworks at Tethys or Helios before departure, or return there to rearm. Delivered lots pay 160 credits each; destroyed lots are recorded as losses, not deliveries. Clearing the site with all cargo lost advances the job without cargo pay.
Run the customs weir with Concord. The pack holding the lane flies a Reach flag too perfectly — break the pattern and the flags resolve.

messages.loc.src.systems.economycontracts.field.b: A carrier filed a 32 t declaration on this unit and the registrar doubts it. Tow it, let the line give the true reading, and file the weight slip at customs — the issuer’s papers are the thing on trial, not yours.

The Variance Office wants this recovered unit audited against its papers, not its weight on faith. The manifest declaration is 20 t. Load it on the line and hold — the rope reads the true weight. Keep the weight slip and file it at customs.

You already know what the line said — declared {slip_declaredMassT} t, reading {slip_measuredMassT} t. That much silence that heavy does not ride a public manifest. Carry one sealed unit to Ceres for me. You earned the ask by holding a scale nobody else bothers to keep.
A sealed consignment, declared 24 t on paper and worth whatever it actually weighs. Recover it — but read it on the line before you land it. Keep the weight slip; Oriel reads scales.
Recover a slag core from the approach and land it at the station. Paid on recovery, not attendance.
messages.loc.src.systems.economycontracts.field.l: That slip you just filed — a manifest reading twenty under its own rope. I have seen that exact lie before: it is the same shape as 47-A. Keep the original slip. Whoever stamps that variance tends to erase the other copy.
messages.loc.src.systems.economycontracts.field.s: Sealed cargo, declared 24 t. Weigh it before you land it; the slip is the negotiation.
Standing port-maintenance work; a physical recovery, not a claim about a new local disaster.
One sealed unit, preloaded, to Ceres. Offered because the rope proved the manifest lied.
A recovery whose manifest declaration is 20 t. Weigh it on the line; file the slip at customs.
A disputed manifest: declared 32 t. The rope gives the reading; customs files it against the issuer.

Your file has a spine now. The margins remember.
Your reads are on file. The Index remembers who read for it.
Forty pages — you are a whole shelf. The stacks honor the donor.
You carried an entry home. The board keeps your name in good ink.
Twenty provenances filed. You read for the stacks now, whether or not you meant to.
A page came home through you. The stacks note the carrier kindly.

Fifteen pages. Your file circulates. The stacks pay a stipend.

messages.loc.src.systems.laneerrands.field.line.0: Hauler: Scoop kissed a pin. I stop. The pin can file itself.
Hauler: That was the boot, not a mayday. Ignore the red.
messages.loc.src.systems.laneerrands.field.line.1: Patrol: {callsign} is {state}. The pin stays on that hull.
Tender: Ribbon on the whistle. I do not wake it.
Crew: Kettle's on. The slot can wait one breath.
Tender: {callsign} is {state}. The ribbon stays dark.
messages.loc.src.systems.laneerrands.field.line.2: Hauler: {callsign} is {state}. That hull gets the lane.
Hauler: Matching the gold heartbeat. A late blink means the post is sick.
messages.loc.src.systems.laneerrands.field.line.3: Patrol: This look is the drill. Your hold stays shut.
Survey: Orange flash on the spar. Not a jump. Looking.
Hauler: Reading the mass aloud. The hold lies less if it hears.
messages.loc.src.systems.laneerrands.field.line.4: Crew: Two hulls, one berth. Hold the outside.
Hauler: Slot says crawl. The band has one lamp and it lies.
Survey: Parking in the barge's shade. Glare lies.
messages.loc.src.systems.laneerrands.field.line.5: Miner: Gel's brown. Swapping the puck. Don't cut my hand.
Survey: That bearing is a lamp, not a star. We look anyway.
Survey: {callsign} is {state}. Shade stays off that hull.
messages.loc.src.systems.laneerrands.field.line.6: Tender: Spare's taped on. Asking before I take it.
messages.loc.src.systems.laneerrands.field.line.7: Salvor: Paying line. The mass is heavier than the chit.
messages.loc.src.systems.laneerrands.field.line.8: Neighbor: Cyan twice. You're seen. That's the courtesy.
Skiff: One lap of the can. No adults in the loop.
Relief: Lamp's yours. I flash twice and I'm gone.
Miner: Turning the scoop. Your dust, not my face.
Survey: Four sides. The rock doesn't get a fifth.
Lane: I'll play the pin once. Filters or silence.
messages.loc.src.systems.laneerrands.field.line.9: Foreman: Cones stay dark. I am not cutting this face.
Hauler: Post's gold is awake. I creep now or I pay twice.
messages.loc.src.systems.laneerrands.field.line.a: Miner: Red cone. I give it the wide number.
Hauler: Air can for a filter. Count both. Don't round.
messages.loc.src.systems.laneerrands.field.line.b: Patrol: Green side. I flash it so the mule doesn't invent one.
Salvor: Line's slack on your side. Mine is not.
Salvor: {callsign} is {state}. The paying line stays clear.
messages.loc.src.systems.laneerrands.field.line.c: Hauler: Cradle's full. I hold until the dent leaves.
messages.loc.src.systems.laneerrands.field.line.d: Miner: {callsign} is {state}. The slot can take the dust.
Hauler: Ash ahead. Half burn. Don't pass inside it.
messages.loc.src.systems.laneerrands.field.line.e: Patrol: Three hulls, one pin. I count them so the log can't.
Patrol: Window's open. The stamp is not. Ref stays Ref.
Survey: Numerals full of grit. Wiping. Claim stays filed.
messages.loc.src.systems.laneerrands.field.line.f: Miner: Your tag snagged my vane. Returning it facing you.
Miner: Dump in three. Flash is the manners I have left.
